blurb:
Immerse yourself in Miami’s famous South Beach area, stroll along the bustling Lincoln Road, and soak up the charm of Espanola Way—a historic South Beach landmark known for its enchanting European ambiance. Whether you're a history buff, architecture lover, or simply looking to enjoy the best of Miami, this tour delivers an unforgettable experience with the city's top attractions!
Discover the vibrant energy of Miami’s most iconic beach neighbourhood on this 2.5-hour South Beach Highlights Walking Tour. Stroll through the National Art Deco District, explore the must-see Lincoln Road Shopping District, and immerse yourself in the charming atmosphere of Espanola Way—all with the guidance of a local expert.
